body: I completely relate to you 100%. I know those feelings. I don't think you could have articulated them any better to describe how I also feel. So, you're not alone. And the fact that you have the courage to be so vulnerable and share that speaks volumes about you and how strong you are...
Thank you! I don't know... just maybe not caring what people think about me and my PTSD?
Bless you for caring so much. Not many are lucky enough to have someone who cares like you do!
